title: Epstein's gravity conference and submarine dives with Hawking in the Bahamas

tellings.quote: Epstein was taking people down in submarines, including Stephven Hawking, to study quantum gravitational anomalies in the Bahamas basin, basically in the Bermuda Triangle region.

related.note: Both describe Stephen Hawking going down in a submarine in the circle around Epstein. This telling says the dive was to look at possible Atlantis ruins, while the story says it was to study gravitational anomalies in the Bahamas basin.

plain: In the 2000s, according to this story, the financier Jeffrey Epstein took people down in submarines in the Bahamas, in what is called the Bermuda Triangle region, to study odd gravity effects at the smallest scales. The physicist Stephen Hawking was said to be among them. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this, passing on what he took from others, among them the mathematician Eric Weinstein, the journalist Whitney Webb and a commentator who goes by Dark Journalist, and from his own online essay about Epstein's associate Ghislaine Maxwell.
